items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: I used to go to many supples and watch Bush Keyes play a guitar.

ctx.x: Yes. So I met a lot of musicians that they just kind of carried over at the way that I played a guitar. Mm-hmm. And they wanted to learn a couple of my notes to what I was picking when I was in Los Angeles. Well, some man that plays a guitar was way over me, but they just couldn't get that card. So, otherwise, when I started out playing a guitar, it must have been long, about, I'd say, 34, anyway, when I started out. Because I used to go to many supples and watch Bush Keyes play a guitar. Before I ever know what…
